senses.sense_definition: An adult who accompanies and supervises young people, especially at a social event or on an outing, to ensure proper behavior.

examples.text: Several parents volunteered to serve as a <w>chaperone</w> on the high school trip to Washington.
The students were not permitted to enter the dance without an adult <w>chaperone</w> present.

senses.sense_definition: A protein that assists in the correct folding or assembly of other macromolecules without forming part of the final structure.

examples.text: Heat shock proteins often function as a molecular <w>chaperone</w> under cellular stress conditions.
Without the assistance of a specific <w>chaperone</w>, newly synthesized proteins may misfold and aggregate.

senses.sense_definition: An employee sent by a British company to work alongside a client in the European Union to bypass post-Brexit restrictions.

examples.text: The consultancy designated him as a corporate <w>chaperone</w> to maintain compliant operations across their European offices.
After new regulations took effect, each local team required a temporary <w>chaperone</w> from the headquarters.

senses.sense_definition: To accompany and supervise someone, especially young people, to ensure safe and proper conduct.

examples.text: Two senior teachers agreed to <w>chaperone</w> the students during their weekend excursion.
Her older brother had to <w>chaperone</w> them whenever they attended evening parties together.
